title: Delocalize Export G/L Entries to XML into Audit File Export framework
summary: The Export G/L Entries to XML feature was moved from French localization into a reusable Audit File Export framework, with a new generic visibility interface letting each export format control UI elements on the export document card.
key_points: Created Audit File Export Page Visibility interface for formats to control field/action visibility
Refactored FEC page extension to use visibility interface instead of hard-coded toggles
Added new XML Audit File app that exports G/L entries to XML through the shared framework
Included XmlPort, data handling, permission sets, setup pages, and test coverage
Registered new app and test projects in build configuration files
quote: To make this capability available beyond FR and reusable across localizations, it needs to be delocalized onto the shared Audit File Export framework.
